texts.html:
verso

  1. هذا مسند عبد الحليم فهمى
  2. بمدرسة القربية فتح
  3. الله عليه وعلى
  4. والديه آمين
  5. يارب
  6. العالمين

texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Nick Posegay and Haitham Mahmoud, "Following the Links in T-S NS 192.11: A Qur’anic Exercise from a Cairene Public School," Fragment of the Month (Cambridge University: Taylor-Schechter Genizah Research Unit, 2020).
texts.html:
1. This is the tradition of ʿAbd al-Ḥalīm Fahmī
  2. at the school of Qarabiyya. May
  3. God grant success to him
  4. and his parents, amen.
  5. O Lord
  6. of the worlds.
